about_the_game:
Toilet Empire – The Kingdom of Cleanliness in Your Hands!


Your goal? Make sure your toilets are clean, modern, and profitable, so customers always leave satisfied… and refreshed!

Expansion & Management – From a Portable Stall to Luxury VIP Toilets!

Your journey begins with a single restroom, but that's just the start! Purchase new plots, invest in bigger and better facilities, and even build exclusive premium toilets for the most demanding customers. Over time, you can create a sanitary network that becomes an essential part of every major city!

Will you go for cheap and functional, or aim for luxury and innovation? The choice is yours!

Cleaning & Maintenance – Hygiene is Everything!

Dirty toilets scare away customers and ruin your reputation! Hire cleaning crews or roll up your sleeves and scrub them yourself. Each toilet needs regular cleaning, waste disposal, and repairs—and sometimes even… disinfection after particularly problematic guests.

Remember to upgrade your facilities with automatic cleaning systems, air fresheners, and even relaxing music to ensure customer comfort.

Business Growth – More Toilets, More Profits!

Expand your company by investing in cutting-edge technologies, such as self-cleaning toilets, automatic temperature regulation, or smart cabins that analyze customer needs. You can also increase fees for high-end restroom access or introduce VIP subscriptions for regular users!

As your empire grows, you can hire managers to optimize operations and logistics experts to ensure smooth business expansion.

Diverse Locations – Sanitary Challenges Around the World!

Your toilets can be found everywhere! Serve parks, shopping malls, beaches, stadiums, festivals, airports, and even space stations!

Customer Interactions – Their Comfort, Your Profit!

Your customers aren’t just nameless NPCs—each one has unique needs and expectations! Some require quick and easy access, while others seek luxury experiences. Keep their satisfaction levels high, gather feedback, and adjust your services accordingly.

Beware of troublemakers—some might leave behind "surprises," while others try to sneak in without paying or even vandalize your facilities!

Unexpected Challenges – Be Ready for Anything!

Running a restroom empire comes with its fair share of surprises! Can you handle:
A sewage system failure during a major festival?
A sudden water shortage across the entire city?
Competitor sabotage, spreading fake negative reviews?
Flooded toilets after heavy rain?
Suspicious customers engaging in illegal activities or vandalizing stalls?

Managing a sanitation empire is no walk in the park—it’s a true test of strategy and business acumen!

Humor & Absurdity – Because Toilets Are More Than Just Business!

The game doesn’t take itself too seriously! Absurd events, bizarre customers, and hilarious challenges make Toilet Empire not just a simulation but also a source of pure entertainment.

A clean deal—jump into Toilet Empire!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommend installation on an SSD drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.0 GHz
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommend installation on an SSD drive

short_description: It's time to build a real sanitary empire! Manage a network of public and portable toilets, ensuring their condition, cleanliness, and expansion. Run your business wisely, you'll soon expand to major cities, sports stadiums, festivals, and prestigious skyscrapers!
